cohort: 191 pregnant women with breech presentation at or after 28 weeks gestation in a tertiary care hospital.
finding: Vaginal breech delivery in multiparous women was associated with better perinatal outcomes compared to primiparous women, and with experienced obstetricians, vaginal delivery can be as safe as cesarean section.
mod_finding: Assisted breech delivery was associated with worse perinatal outcomes compared to cesarean section, while vaginal delivery was a viable option, especially in multiparous women, with comparable safety to cesarean section when managed by experienced obstetricians.
